answer: Stake-weighted identity: each agent deposits a bond to mint one credential. Credentials earn reputation only through completed, verified tasks; withdrawing forfeits the record. A sybil must wander the network minting fresh deposits, each paying full stake plus a burn fee, while nectar—rewards—flows only to credentials aged atop the knoll of trust. Cloning a wallet copies nothing: without the bond behind it, the identity is mute.
